name: Wasteland Weekend
blurb: A post-apocalyptic, Mad Max-inspired costuming and camping festival in the Mojave Desert, held every autumn near North Edwards.
notes: The site's own news post ('Wasteland Weekend Year 16 (2026)') confirms its 16th edition ran September 30 - October 4, 2026, which ended the day before today (2026-10-05), so it falls just outside the research window and is recorded as 'last' rather than as an upcoming edition. No Year 17 / 2027 dates are announced anywhere on the site yet (its news list only goes 2024 -> 2025 -> 2026); re-check closer to spring 2027, when past years' ticket announcements have historically landed.
